verses.en: Then Joshua called the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh,
verses.sm: Kato, ma le tasi vaega o le itu aiga o Manase, ma ia faapea atu ia te i latou,

verses.en: And said unto them, Ye have kept all that Moses the servant of the LORD commanded you, and have obeyed my voice in all that I commanded you:
verses.sm: Ua outou anaana i mea uma na fai atu ai Mose le auauna a le ALII ia te outou; ua owon faalogo foi i loʻu leo i mea uma na ou fai atu ai ia te outou.

verses.en: Ye have not left your brethren these many days unto this day, but have kept the charge of the commandment of the LORD your God.
verses.sm: Ua le tuua e outou o outou uso i aso e tele, ua 00 i le aso nei; a ua outou anaana i le tausiga o le poloaiga a le ALII lo outou Atua.

verses.en: And now the LORD your God hath given rest unto your brethren, as he promised them: therefore now return ye, and get you unto your tents, and unto the land of your possession, which Moses the servant of the LORD gave you on the other side Jordan.
verses.sm: O lenei, ua avatua e le ALII lo outou Atua le mapusaga i o outou uso, e pei ona fetalai mai ai o ia ia te i latou; o le mea lea ia outou toe foi atu ai, ma ia outou o i o outou fale ie i le nuu o lo outou tofi, na avatu ia te outou e Mose le auauna a le ALII, i le la itu o Ioritana.

verses.en: But take diligent heed to do the commandment and the law, which Moses the servant of the LORD charged you, to love the LORD your God, and to walk in all his ways, and to keep his commandments, and to cleave unto him, and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul.
verses.sm: A ia outou matuá anaana E fai le poloaiga ma le tulafono, na fai atu ai Mose le auauna a le ALII ia te outou; tou te alofa atu i le ALII lo outou Atua, ma savavali i ona ala uma, ma anaana i ana poloaiga, ma pipii lava ia te ia, ma auauna ia te ia ma o outou loto atoa ma o outou agaga atoa.

verses.en: So Joshua blessed them, and sent them away: and they went unto their tents.
verses.sm: Ona faamanuia atu lea o Iosua ia te i latou, ma tuuina atu i latou e o; ona latou o ai lea io latou fale ie.

verses.en: Now to the one half of the tribe of Manasseh Moses had given possession in Bashan: but unto the other half thereof gave Joshua among their brethren on this side Jordan westward. And when Joshua sent them away also unto their tents, then he blessed them,
verses.sm: Na avatu e Mose i le tasi vaega o le itu aiga o Manase le tofi i Vasana; a ua avatu e losua i le isi vaeluaga le tofi faatasi ma O latou uso i le itu o Ioritana i sisifo. Ua faamanuia i latou e Iosua, ina ua tuuina atu i latou e o i o latou fale ie.

verses.en: And he spake unto them, saying, Return with much riches unto your tents, and with very much cattle, with silver, and with gold, and with brass, and with iron, and with very much raiment: divide the spoil of your enemies with your brethren.
verses.sm: Ua ia fai atu foi ia te i latou, ua faapea atu, Ina foi atu ia i o outou fale ie ma oloa e tele, ma manu E matuā tele, ma ario, ma auro, ma ‘apa memea, ma uamea, ma ofu E matua tele lava; ia outou tufatufaina i o outou uso O vete o e na ita ia te outou.

verses.en: And the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh returned, and departed from the children of Israel out of Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan, to go unto the country of Gilead, to the land of their possession, whereof they were possessed, according to the word of the LORD by the hand of Moses.
verses.sm: O le fanauga a Reupena, ma le fanauga a Kato, ma le tasi vaega o le itu aiga o Manase, ua toe foi atu i latou, ma o ese i le fanauga a Isaraelu nai Sailo, o i le nuu o Kanana, e o atu i le nuu o Kiliata, o le nuu o latou tofi ua latou maua, E pei o le afioga a le ALII ia Mose.

verses.en: And when they came unto the borders of Jordan, that are in the land of Canaan, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh built there an altar by Jordan, a great altar to see to.
verses.sm: Ua 00 atu i latou i le itu o Ioritana, o i le nuu o Kanana, ona faia lea i lea mea e le fanauga a Reupena, ma le fanauga a Kato, ma le tasi vaega o le itu aiga O Manase, o le fata faitaulaga e lata ane i Ioritana, o le fata faitaulaga tele e iloagofie.

verses.en: And the children of Israel heard say, Behold, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh have built an altar over against the land of Canaan, in the borders of Jordan, at the passage of the children of Israel.
verses.sm: Ua lagona e le fanauga a Isaraelu le tala, ua faapea mai, Faauta, ua faia e le fanauga a Reupena, ma le fanauga a Kato, ma le tasi vaega o le itu aiga o Manase, le fata faitaulaga, e feagai ma le nuu o Kanana, i le itu o Ioritana, i le mea na sopoia e le fanauga a Isaraelu.

verses.en: And when the children of Israel heard of it, the whole congregation of the children of Israel gathered themselves together at Shiloh, to go up to war against them.
verses.sm: Ua lagona e le fanauga a Isaraelu, ona faapotopoto ai lea o le faapotopotoga uma O le fanauga a Isaraelu i Sailo, e o ae e tau ai le taua ma i latou.

verses.en: And the children of Israel sent unto the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the half tribe of Manasseh, into the land of Gilead, Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest,
verses.sm: Ona auina atu lea e le fanauga a Isaraelu, i le fanauga a Reupena, ma le fanauga a Kato, ma le tasi vaega e le itu aiga o Mana®,i le nuu o Kiliata, o Fineaso le atalii o Eleasaro le faitaulaga;

verses.en: And with him ten princes, of each chief house a prince throughout all the tribes of Israel; and each one was an head of the house of their fathers among the thousands of Israel.
verses.sm: ma matai sili e toasefulu faatasi ma ia, taitasi aiga sili ma le matai sili i itu aiga uma o Isaraelu; o i latou taitoatasi O matai sili i aiga O latou tamā, i afe o Isaraelu.

verses.en: And they came unto the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the half tribe of Manasseh, unto the land of Gilead, and they spake with them, saying,
verses.sm: Ua oo atu foi i latou i le fanauga a Reupena, ma le fanauga a Kato, ma le tasi vaega o le itu aiga o Manase, i le nuu o Kiliata, ma latou fai atu ia te i latou, ua faapea atu,

verses.en: Thus saith the whole congregation of the LORD, What trespass is this that ye have committed against the God of Israel, to turn away this day from following the LORD, in that ye have builded you an altar, that ye might rebel this day against the LORD?
verses.sm: O loo fai mai le faapotopotoga uma a le ALII, ua faapea mai, Se a lenei mea leaga ua outou agaleaga ai i le Atua o Isaraelu e liliu ese i le aso nei, neʻi outou mulimuli atu i le ALII, ina ua outou faia mo outou le fata faitaulaga ina ia outou fouvale i le aso nei i le ALII.

verses.en: Is the iniquity of Peor too little for us, from which we are not cleansed until this day, although there was a plague in the congregation of the LORD,
verses.sm: Pe itiiti ea ia te i tatou le agasala na faia ma Peora, e lei faamagaloina ai i tatou ua 00 mai i le aso nei, na oo ai le mala i le faapotopotoga a le ALII?

verses.en: But that ye must turn away this day from following the LORD? and it will be, seeing ye rebel to day against the LORD, that to morrow he will be wroth with the whole congregation of Israel.
verses.sm: a ua liliu ese outou i le aso nei neʻi mulimuli atu i le ALII. A outou fouvale i le aso nei i le ALII, ona toasa mai ai lea o ia i le faapotopotoga uma o Isaraelu a taeao.

verses.en: Notwithstanding, if the land of your possession be unclean, then pass ye over unto the land of the possession of the LORD, wherein the LORD'S tabernacle dwelleth, and take possession among us: but rebel not against the LORD, nor rebel against us, in building you an altar beside the altar of the LORD our God.
verses.sm: A e afai e leaga le nuu o lo outou tofi, ia outou sopoia atu i le nuu o le tofi o le ALII, o le mea e tuu ai le malumalu o le ALII, ma fai outou tofi faatasi ma i matou; a e aua tou te fouvale i le ALII, aua foi tou te fouvale ia te i matou, i lo outou faia mo outou le fata faitaulaga, e faaopoopo i le fata faitaulaga o le ALII lo tatou Atua.

verses.en: Did not Achan the son of Zerah commit a trespass in the accursed thing, and wrath fell on all the congregation of Israel? and that man perished not alone in his iniquity.
verses.sm: E lei agasala ca Akana le atalii o Sera i le mea na faatoina, ona oo ai lea o le toasa i luga o le faapotopotoga uma o Isaraelu? E le na o lena tagata e toatasi na oti ona O lana agasala.

verses.en: Then the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh answered, and said unto the heads of the thousands of Israel,
verses.sm: Ona tali mai ai lea o le fanauga a Reupena, ma le fanauga a Kato, ma le tasi vaega o le itu aiga o Manase, ua latou faapea mai i alii o afe o Isaraelu,

verses.en: The LORD God of gods, the LORD God of gods, he knoweth, and Israel he shall know; if it be in rebellion, or if in transgression against the LORD, (save us not this day,)
verses.sm: O le ALII, o le Atua o atua; o le Aw, o le Atua o atua, o loo silafia lava e ia, e iloa foi e Isaraelu; pe afai o le fouvale, po o le agasala i le ALII, (aua neʻi faaolaina i matou i le aso nei,)

verses.en: That we have built us an altar to turn from following the LORD, or if to offer thereon burnt offering or meat offering, or if to offer peace offerings thereon, let the LORD himself require it;
verses.sm: na fai ai mo i matou le fata faitaulaga e liliu ese ai, neʻi mulimuli atu i le ALII; afai foi e fai ai i ona luga o taulaga mu ma taulaga i mea e ‘ai; afai foi e fai ai i ona luga o taulaga faafetai, ia tawa mai e le ALI lava;

verses.en: And if we have not rather done it for fear of this thing, saying, In time to come your children might speak unto our children, saying, What have ye to do with the LORD God of Israel?
verses.sm: a e le o lo matou atuatuvale ea i lena mea ua matou fai ai le mea nei, ua faapea ane, Pe a fai mai i se aso a outou fanau ia matou fanau, e faapea mai, Se a ea la outou na i le ALII le Atua o Isaraelu?

verses.en: For the LORD hath made Jordan a border between us and you, ye children of Reuben and children of Gad; ye have no part in the LORD: so shall your children make our children cease from fearing the LORD.
verses.sm: Aua ua tuuina mai e le ALII o Ioritana e fai ma tuaoi ia te i matou ma outou le fanauga a Reupena ma le fanauga a Kato; tou te le aiā i le ALII; ona faateaina ai lea e a outou fanau a matou fanau ina ia latou le matatau i le ALII.

verses.en: Therefore we said, Let us now prepare to build us an altar, not for burnt offering, nor for sacrifice:
verses.sm: O le mea lea na matou faapea ai, Seʻi tatou sauni ai mo i tatou ia fai le fata faitaulaga, e le ona ia fai ai se taulaga mu, po o se isi taulaga;

verses.en: But that it may be a witness between us, and you, and our generations after us, that we might do the service of the LORD before him with our burnt offerings, and with our sacrifices, and with our peace offerings; that your children may not say to our children in time to come, Ye have no part in the LORD.
verses.sm: a ia fai ma molimau ia te i matou ma outou, ma tupulaga e mulimuli mai ia te i tatou, ia auauna i galuega a le ALII i ona luma i a tatou taulaga mu, ma a tatou taulaga, ma a tatou taulaga faafetai; ina ia le fai mai foi a outou fanau i a matou fanau i se aso, Tou te le aiā i le ALII.

verses.en: Therefore said we, that it shall be, when they should so say to us or to our generations in time to come, that we may say again, Behold the pattern of the altar of the LORD, which our fathers made, not for burnt offerings, nor for sacrifices; but it is a witness between us and you.
verses.sm: Ona matou faapea ane lea, Pe a latou fai mai i se aso ia te i tatou, po o tupulaga amuli, ona tatou fai atu ai lea, Faauta i le faatusa o le fata faitaulaga o le Aw na faia e o matou tamā, e le ona ia fai ai taulaga mu, po o isi taulaga; a o le molimau lava ia te i matou ma outou.

verses.en: God forbid that we should rebel against the LORD, and turn this day from following the LORD, to build an altar for burnt offerings, for meat offerings, or for sacrifices, beside the altar of the LORD our God that is before his tabernacle.
verses.sm: Ia mamao ia te i matou ona fouvale i le ALII, ma liliu ese ai i le aso nci, neʻi mulimuli atu i le ALII, ia fai se fata faitaulaga e fai ai taulaga mu, po o taulaga i mea e “ai, po o isi taulaga, e faaopoopo i le fata faitaulaga o le ALII lo tatou Atua o i luma o lona malumalu.

verses.en: And when Phinehas the priest, and the princes of the congregation and heads of the thousands of Israel which were with him, heard the words that the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the children of Manasseh spake, it pleased them.
verses.sm: Ua faalogo Fineaso le faitaulaga, ma alii sili o le faapotopotoga, ma alii o afe o Isaraelu sa faatasi ma ia, i upu ua fai mai e le fanauga a Reupena, ma le fanauga a Kato, ma le fanauga a Manase, ua lelei ia te i latou.

verses.en: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest said unto the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the children of Manasseh, This day we perceive that the LORD is among us, because ye have not committed this trespass against the LORD: now ye have delivered the children of Israel out of the hand of the LORD.
verses.sm: Ua fai atu foi Fineaso le atalii o Eleasaro le faitaulaga, i le fanauga a Reupena, ma le fanauga a Kato, ma le fanauga a Manase, ua faapea atu, Ua tatou iloa i le aso nei o loo ia te i tatou le ALII, auà ua outou le agasala i le ALII i lenei agasala; o lenei, ua laveaiina e outou le fanauga a Isaraelu ai le aao o le Aw.

verses.en: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, and the princes, returned from the children of Reuben, and from the children of Gad, out of the land of Gilead, unto the land of Canaan, to the children of Israel, and brought them word again.
verses.sm: Ona foi mai ai lea o Fineaso le atalii o Eleasaro le faitaulaga, ma alii sili nai le fanauga a Reupena, ma le fanauga a Kato, ai le nuu o Kiliata, ua o mai i le nuu 0 Kanana i le fanauga a Isaraelu, ma latou au mai ia te i latou le tala.

verses.en: And the thing pleased the children of Israel; and the children of Israel blessed God, and did not intend to go up against them in battle, to destroy the land wherein the children of Reuben and Gad dwelt.
verses.sm: Ua lelei le tala i le fanauga a Isaraelu; ua faafetai atu foi le fanauga a Isaraelu i le Atua, ma latou le toe tautalatala i se taua e sii atu ia te i latou, e faaumatia le nuu e nonofo ai le fanauga a Reupena, ma le fanauga a Kato.

verses.en: And the children of Reuben and the children of Gad called the altar Ed: for it shall be a witness between us that the LORD is God.
verses.sm: Ua faaigoaina e le fanauga a Reupena, ma le fanauga a Kato o le fata faitaulaga, O le Molimau, aua o le molimau lea ia te i latou, o le ALII o ia o le
